title: ProductCreated.v1
description: Emitted when a new product is created via the product wizard, including its initial team and application assignments.

name.description: Display name of the newly created product.
name.markdownDescription: Display name of the newly created product.

teamIds.description: IDs of the teams assigned to this product at creation time.
teamIds.markdownDescription: IDs of the teams assigned to this product at creation time.

componentIds.description: IDs of the application components linked to this product at creation time.
componentIds.markdownDescription: IDs of the application components linked to this product at creation time.

origin.description: How the product was built: 'bespoke' (internally built), 'open-source', or 'vendor' (third-party).
origin.markdownDescription: How the product was built: 'bespoke' (internally built), 'open-source', or 'vendor' (third-party).

isExternal.description: Whether this product is externally owned or managed.
isExternal.markdownDescription: Whether this product is externally owned or managed.

productManagerId.description: User ID of the assigned product manager.
productManagerId.markdownDescription: User ID of the assigned product manager.

engineeringLeadId.description: User ID of the assigned engineering lead.
engineeringLeadId.markdownDescription: User ID of the assigned engineering lead.

supportChannel.description: Support channel identifier, e.g. a Slack channel name.
supportChannel.markdownDescription: Support channel identifier, e.g. a Slack channel name.
